sources.title: DAS Vitamin Cocktail | UTEX Culture Collection of Algae
sources.recipe_text: Directions For 100 mL Total To approximately 85 mL of dH2O add Tricine while stirring continuously. Adjust the pH to 8.0. Add each of the remaining components in the order listed. Bring total volume to 100 mL with dH2O. Sterilize the vitamin cocktail by filtration through a 0.45 µm Millipore filter. Store in the dark at freezer temperature. # Component Amount Stock Solution Concentration Final Concentration in DAS 1 Tricine(adjust to pH 8)(Sigma T 5816-256) 0.9 g/100 mL 2 Thiamine(Sigma T 1270) 0.067 g/100 mL 2.0 mM 0.99 µM 3 Biotin(Sigma B 4639) 0.001 g/100 mL 0.041 mM 0.02 µM 4 Vitamin B12(add after autoclaving)(Sigma V 6629) 0.0008 g/100 mL 0.0059 mM 0.0029 µM 5 Pantothenate(Sigma P 2250) 0.002 g/100 mL 0.091 mM 0.046 µM 6 PABA(p-aminobenzoic acid)(Sigma A 1174) 0.004 g/100 mL 0.291 mM 0.15 µM
